show.line: Sixty-seven take away twenty-three. Take the tens: sixty-seven, forty-seven. Take the ones: forty-four!

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! Seventy-six take away thirty-two.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: Seventy-six take away thirty is forty-six. Take two more. Forty-eight!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! I added the two. Forty-six take away two is forty-four.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's take the ones away together. Forty-six, forty-five, forty-four!

parent_line: Can add and take away two-digit numbers up to 99.
